### Exclusion/inclusion criteria/checks

> First exclusions based off % of trials w/ marker flatlining.
> Simplifying checks to the primary movement axis, Z (for/back-ward)

```{r Get distance travelled}
z_slopes <- dt[,
  .(slope = round(diff(range(hand_z)), digits = 2)),
  by = .(
    participant_id,
    trial_num,
    left_right_hand,
    palm_back_hand,
    target_loc,
    distractor_loc
  )
]

# fwrite(z_slopes, here::here("data", "scratch", "03_z_slopes.csv")) # nolint

pclid(z_slopes$slope)
summary(z_slopes$slope)
# Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.
# 0.00    0.00   31.63   23.69   39.47   64.08
```

> [!Note]
> Target objects were placed ~35 cm anterior to Ss.
> But there is a fair amount of noise in the data.
> So, we'll consider any slope > 20 cm as a good trial, and reassess later.

```{r Flag & tally slopes}
good_enough <- z_slopes[,
  .(
    acceptable_slopes = round(
      sum(slope > 20) / .N,
      digits = 2
    )
  ),
  keyby = .(left_right_hand, palm_back_hand, participant_id)
] |>
  _[
    ,
    good_enough := acceptable_slopes > 0.8
  ] |>
  dcast(
    data = _,
    ... ~ left_right_hand + palm_back_hand
  ) |>
  _[
    ,
    .(
      left = sum(c(Left_Back, Left_Front), na.rm = TRUE),
      right = sum(c(Right_Back, Right_Front), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    keyby = .(participant_id)
  ]

z_slopes[,
  .(
    flat_rate = round(sum(slope < 1) / .N, digits = 2)
  ),
  keyby = .(target_loc, distractor_loc, participant_id)
] |>
  dcast(data = _, ... ~ target_loc + distractor_loc)
```
